# September 2026

The summer job ended on the 5th. Both weekend days came back, and the week was rewritten the same week: weight off the late evenings, onto Saturday and Sunday mornings. September is the month that proves the new week holds before the first DS series.

# Goals

Educational

- [ ] Maths: 17 or more at the first DS
- [ ] NSI: 17 or more
- [x] Fewer than 10 hours of absence
- [ ] Russell: read every evening
- [ ] The weekend blocks run four weekends out of four

Financial

- [x] No new weekend job: studies are the job this year
- [x] End the month at or above the planned balance

Personal

- [ ] In bed by 23h00
- [ ] Cardio four times a week
- [ ] Thirty minutes with each sibling every Sunday
- [x] No side projects until the bac

# Review

Educational

Maths held on 20 of the 24 days it was due, NSI on 11 of 21. The first DS gave 15 in maths, under the 17 aimed at. School was never missed. Russell was read 13 evenings of 24, and histoire-géo never got its Sunday hour.

Grade: 6/10

Financial

No weekend job taken. The month ended on the planned balance.

Grade: 8/10

Personal

Bed by 23h00 held 7 nights of 24, and the cause is the same every time: the phone in the room. Cardio ran 3 times out of 10. The Sunday block with the siblings held two Sundays of three.

Grade: 4/10

Overall

The week itself is right: on the days that were marked, most of the study blocks were done. What failed is everything after 19h00. October keeps the week as it is and changes one thing: the phone stays out of the room.

Overall: 6/10
